name: Fiocchi d’avena
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one isolated food illustration for PREVEDIApp's interactive pantry and plate. It will be displayed at 48 to 64 pixels beside a food name, and must match the existing ingredient illustrations.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background; no landscape, white rectangle, painted checkerboard, circle, badge, drop shadow or floor.
Style/medium: friendly botanical gouache and clean storybook watercolor, calm natural Terra palette, matte hand-painted surfaces, subtle shading, rounded organic shapes, restrained earthy-brown contours around #6B6358. Match an existing family of watercolor broccoli, spinach, sliced tomato, rustic bowls of quinoa and brown rice, wholegrain bread, salmon, chicken and tofu. Slightly detailed edible ingredients with broad clear silhouettes, never photorealistic or 3D.
Composition/framing: square canvas, one compact centered isolated motif, full silhouette visible, around 78 percent of canvas occupied, balanced transparent margins on all four sides. Three-quarter overhead view where appropriate. All named food forms grouped closely to remain recognizable at 48 pixels. No garnish, utensils, other food, human hands, characters or faces.
Palette: natural forest and sage greens, muted warm ochre for grain and bowl, earthy brown, warm ivory. Natural muted carrot orange where required. Soft diffuse light, no dramatic glossy highlights.
Constraints: no lettering, numerals, labels, branding, watermark, interface, border, frame, symbols, medical claims, quantity markings, fabricated background or shiny 3D plastic. Generate one complete illustration rather than an atlas or grid.
Subject: A small shallow rustic warm-ochre ceramic bowl filled with rolled oat flakes. Clearly flattened pale ivory and tan oval flakes overlapping, not rice grains and not porridge; compact bowl, no spoon, liquid, fruit or garnish.
transformation: Mechanical 512x512 resize and WebP quality88 encoding; alpha preserved; no artistic post-processing.
